newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan vegoil rates seen down on fresh supplies.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan vegoil rates seen down on fresh supplies.

text.p: Pakistani vegetable oil rates are likely to slip next week on fresh imports and the downward trend would continue for several weeks as local crops reach the market, dealers said on Friday.

"Vegoil stocks will rise on arrival of imported and local supplies in the coming days which will bring down prices," a dealer at Saulat Enterprises said. "Local supply of rapeseed, canola and sunflower has already started and is estimated at 40,000 to 50,000 tonnes a month from April to July."
Dealers said four more ships with around 70,500 tonnes of vegoil were due in April.
Vegoil stocks rose to around 148,000 tonnes, including 80,000 tonnes of RBD palm oil and olein, from 130,000 tonnes on April 11.
